settings.title: Settings.
settings.intro: Keys for machines and agents, and where your team is managed.
settings.apiKeysIntro: Keys for machines and agents. A key acts in the view of the person who created it; a worker key sees organisation-wide rows only. The plaintext is shown exactly once.
settings.keyCreated: New key created. Copy it now, it will not be shown again (this box disappears after one minute):
settings.noKeysBody: Create a key above when a machine or an agent should work with this Lab.
settings.teamBody: Who is in your organisation and who may use this Lab is managed in the Beyondles Suite, not here.

noAccess.titleUnreachable: ExampleLab is closed for a moment
noAccess.bodyUnreachable: The Beyondles Suite is currently unreachable, so ExampleLab stays closed as a precaution. Please try again later.
noAccess.titleNotConfigured: ExampleLab is not fully set up here yet
noAccess.bodyNotConfigured: This environment cannot ask the Beyondles platform who may use ExampleLab, so it stays closed for everyone. This is not about your account. The operator sets PLATFORM_API_URL and PLATFORM_API_KEY and restarts.
noAccess.bodyAllowed: This page is just a notice. Your account is enabled.

states.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or it is not visible to you.

picker.collectionHint: Everyone in the chosen collection sees it.
picker.organisationHint: Every member of your organisation sees it.
